environment.virtualizer: QEMU 11.1.3 with local WHPX fixes; socket Ethernet switch with TCP_NODELAY

method.noise_payload: one random payload reused within each trial
method.baseline: ordinary grouped prefilter plus unchanged kernel guard; no IFB
method.ifb1024: same guard/filter plus TBF 200 Mbit/s, burst 65536 bytes, limit 1048576 bytes
method.dnat: ordinary forwarding without experimental guard/filter or IFB
method.cpu_busy_definition: first eight /proc/stat counters; user+nice+system+irq+softirq divided by their sum with idle, iowait and steal
method.sample_selection: complete intervals inside each guest before/after TCP snapshot window, including warmup and management overhead
method.sampler_cpu_definition: process CPU during the sampling loop and signal handling; excludes startup/imports and final JSON encoding
method.four_sample_definition: sliding sum of ticks over four consecutive intervals, weighted by tick counts; actual elapsed nanoseconds retained
method.perf: ordinary grouped binary; cpu-clock at requested 199 Hz; monotonic clock; process-attached; report restricted to entry TCP snapshot window
method.stacks: two additional trials with frame-pointer callchains; kernel paths unwind, userspace often unresolved
method.quality: sender rate within 1%, entry delivery within 1%, no virtual-switch drops required for rate-qualified comparisons
method.counts: ingress gated, queues drained, outcomes stable before counter subtraction
